profile.input_contract: JSON coolant, power, and friction-factor parameters for a reduced subchannel model.
profile.output_contract: JSON thermal-hydraulic metrics such as delta_T and pressure/friction summaries.
profile.adapter: Python analytical runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/subchannel_1d/.

mrs.description: Energy conservation MP_mono: at fixed wall heat flux q'' and inlet temperature, ΔT = q''·P_h·L/(G·A_xs·c_p) is inversely proportional to mass flux G — higher flow strictly decreases the outlet temperature rise.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Energy conservation MP_mono: at fixed wall heat flux q'' and inlet temperature, ΔT = q''·P_h·L/(G·A_xs·c_p) is inversely proportional to mass flux G — higher flow strictly decreases the outlet temperature rise.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/boundary/mass_flux] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `delta_T` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `subchannel-flow-temperature-monotone`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `less` / `LessThan` checks the expected relation on `delta_T`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `subchannel-1d` exposes sample `sample/pwr_channel.json`, the transform target fields, and output `delta_T`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Energy conservation MP_mono (linearity in heat input): doubling the wall heat flux q'' must strictly increase ΔT (in fact, by the same factor) because energy balance is linear in q'' at constant flow.

mrs.description: Decoupling invariance MP_inv: in this lumped 0D-axial energy balance the friction factor f only enters the momentum equation (Δp = f·L·G²/(2·ρ·D_h)). It does NOT appear in the energy balance ΔT = q''·P_h·L/(G·A_xs·c_p). Doubling f must therefore leave delta_T bit-identical (analytical closed-form invariance — no FD truncation involved).
